Senses.Explanation: Steaming sand in order to make rice pictures labor whose material cannot produce the intended meal. Chan speakers use the image to reject exertion founded on the wrong basis: the records explicitly say “sand is not the basis of rice,” and apply the verdict to mistaken identification, hollow display, and efforts said not to reach their stated end even over vast time.
